properties.name: Arvato
properties.description:
Logistics may sound simple. Goods in, goods out. In reality, it is a key driver of growth, resilience and customer experience.

Arvato is a global 3PL service provider specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. We enable global companies to bring their supply chain strategies into high-performing operations that are fast, precise and reliable.

By combining deep industry expertise with advanced technologies, we design and operate complex distribution and fulfillment networks tailored to our clients’ needs. Across Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publishing, we create supply chains that go beyond delivery and actively strengthen our clients’ market position.

Our teams bring this to life every day. Across more than 100 locations worldwide, over 20,000 employees work with a strong focus on technology, data and operational excellence to deliver resilient performance and adapt quickly to changing business needs. They are all connected by a shared mindset that is collaborative, hands-on and always moving forward.

Our solutions are built to scale, designed for sustainability and ready for what comes next.

properties.name: Think Logistics
properties.description:
Part of Arvato since March 2026, a global third-party logistics provider with 20,000 employees across Europe, the U.S., and APAC. 

Think Logistics is a world class third-party logistics company providing end-end supply chain solutions for businesses across various industries. A highly customer focus dedicated 3PL providing fast, reliable and cost-effective fulfillment solutions enabling our customers to deliver on their brands promise. Being Customer centric is at the core of our DNA.

We work with internationally recognized brands to provide customized engineered fulfillment solutions leveraging our nationwide facility network. Our expertise extends across various sectors, including e-commerce fulfillment, omnichannel distribution, retail fulfillment and value added services. We understand the distinct requirements of each industry and customize our solutions accordingly. 

OUR STORY:

Think Logistics began with a shared vision among a group of industry veterans and tech entrepreneurs who recognized the need for a fresh approach to logistics. In 2011, our founders came together with a wealth of experience and a burning desire to transform the way businesses handle their supply chains. 

Our journey started with a simple yet ambitious goal: to provide comprehensive logistics solutions that combine cutting-edge technology, industry expertise and unparalleled customer service. We set out to build a company that would revolutionize the logistics landscape, delivering seamless end-to-end solutions to businesses of all sizes. With our initial multi-million dollar investment in Kiva Robotics we launched Canada's first autonomous mobile robotic fulfillment system in 2012.

Get in Touch with us:
https://www.thinklogistics.com/contact/
